_comment: Mutation testing for the consent/correctness-critical strategies: the mandatory consent pipeline (cookie verify + gate, evidence-log KV write-amp dedup, jurisdiction resolution, troll-shield heuristics), the analytics sinks' row projection + delivery recording (clickhouse/otel/tinybird), the ad-network destinationsAllowed gating, and drift detection. Excluded: index.ts (manifest/re-export glue only). Not run per-PR (see .github/workflows/mutation.yml: nightly + workflow_dispatch). Residual survivors (score achieved: 99.7) are 2 equivalent mutants in troll-shield.ts: `ua.trim() === ''` vs `ua === ''` — unobservable because the WHATWG Headers implementation strips leading/trailing HTTP whitespace at set/get time, so a whitespace-only User-Agent already reads back as ''; and `botScore !== null && botScore > 0` — the null guard is subsumed by `null > 0 === false`, kept as an explicit type guard for readability.
